## Purpose
Retrieval panels. "Try retrieval" shows exactly what a build with a given goal would receive, per layer. "Feedback" shows how the builds that used each guidance item ended.

## Responsibilities
- `TryRetrievalPanel` uses `knowledgeApi.retrieve`. `FeedbackPanel` uses `knowledgeApi.feedback`.
